author: Emmanuel Mendez
title: Lionel Messi Reveals Hidden Fear After Inter Miami's Win Over Orlando City - NewsBreak
text:
By Emmanuel Mendez ,
12 minutes ago
Inter Miami reached the final of the Leagues Cup as they defeated Orlando City 3-1 in the semifinals at Chase Stadium. A brace from Lionel Messi and a goal from Telasco Segovia sealed the comeback win for the Herons.
Orlando City took the lead in the first half when Marco Pasalic scored in the 46th minute. Messi reaches his 50th career final and his second Leagues Cup final with Inter Miami in three years.
In 2023, Inter Miami with Messi won the first Leagues Cup, which included multiple MLS and Liga MX teams in the competition. Inter Miami reaching the final also confirms the team's qualification for the 2026 CONCACAF Champions Cup .
Messi has not played for Inter Miami since August 16 against LA Galaxy in the MLS and missed two straight games last week. Despite the impressive performance, Messi admits he was slightly concerned heading into the match against Orlando City.
Lionel Messi Messi's performance against Orlando City is praised after the Argentine star missed a week of football, and the star admits to being afraid of risking another injury during the first half against Orlando City.
Messi suffered an injury against Club Necaxa on August 2, which led to him coming off in the 11th minute of the game.
Lionel Messi: "I wanted to be present since my return against Galaxy. I felt discomfort then and I wasn’t comfortable. I prepared well for this match because I knew how important it was, and the importance of the opponent, a very tough opponent. This season, we couldn’t win in the two previous matches against them. The first half I played with a little bit of fear, but in the second half, I felt looser."
Messi missed four games with Inter Miami this month due to his injury. Messi has just played his third game in the Leagues Cup with Inter Miami, and his fourth match will be the final, which is on Sunday, August 31.
Jorge Mas Before Inter Miami vs Orlando City Just minutes before the kickoff between Inter Miami against Orlando City, Inter Miami co-owner Jorge Mas revealed that Messi was still not 100% fit for the match. Javier Mascherano and the coaching staff were cautious about playing the Argentine star.
Due to the importance of the game, which was a semifinal, the coaching staff decided to play Messi, and he stayed on for the whole game. The plan delivered, but Mas' words before the game suggest that Messi's playing against Orlando City was a risk.
Jorge Mas: "Messi is injured, but he wants to play and desires to win; he doesn’t want to sit in the stands next to us in a match of this importance. I’ve said it before, he’s a competitive beast, and he’s here for one reason: to win."
